_note: Short factual 'good to know' notes shown in the browser details dialog. Facts only, no recommendations.
avast-secure-browser: Avast sold users' browsing data through its Jumpshot subsidiary until 2020 (FTC settlement in 2024).
avg-secure-browser: Same Gen Digital codebase and company as Avast Secure Browser.
avira-secure-browser: Owned by Gen Digital, the company behind Avast, AVG and Norton. Bundled with Avira's antivirus products.
norton-private-browser: Gen Digital also ships Norton Neo, a separate AI-focused browser.
yandex-browser: Data goes to a company under Russian jurisdiction and its data-access laws.
crest: Early access: started in August 2026 and still pre-1.0 (0.10 nightlies), with most commits from one developer working with AI coding agents. Its site says security hasn't been independently audited.
ardia: Early access: started in June 2026, ships 0.2 nightly builds and has around 800 open issues. Developed largely with AI coding agents.
wren: A rewrite of Flow Browser: the current project started in October 2026 (v0.8) and is built by one developer.
